c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Human-directed cycle: harden the four consolidated packages by (a) scanning the superpowers skill library (upcoming challenger to Pocock) for relevant adoptable ideas, and (b) settling how skills/engine work can be made testable near-term. Flavor labeled refine (hardening current candidates); content set by the human directly. Also fed into package A this cycle: the hardcoded 'py' launcher keyword is not portable and burns agent tokens — make launcher resolution robust.
c0-frame.finding: human-directed: two research excursions + py-hardcode item into package A

x3.title: Excursion: superpowers competitor scan
x3.imperative: ONE question: what has the superpowers skill library shipped recently that is relevant to the four packages (engine answerability, step-back phase, slice-wise planning, conductor inversion), and what is worth adopting on merit? House stance: superpowers is a competitor, never cited as authority — ideas adopted on merit only; consolidation yes, prevention machinery no. Brief at excursions/x3-superpowers-BRIEF.md; background dispatch via run_crew.py; scoped nulls.
x3.finding: Superpowers scanned on merit: 4 adoptables (batched plan-conflict pre-flight; capability-escalation loop primitive; return-thin/write-fat contract; task-sizing heuristic + inline file-growth smell), 1 honest fork surfaced for C (static-fine-grained vs rolling-wave/regenerate), D risk named (teams-API instability made competitor back off controller model) + D constraint (recursive-delegation guard), B validated as differentiator (their gate blind to test adequacy). Board ideas 29-32 added.

x4.title: Excursion: skill/engine testability near-term
x4.imperative: ONE question: what is the cheapest robust near-term way to make constellation skills and the engine testable — inventory what exists (engine tests, run_skill_eval.py, #136, #205), survey how others test agent skills, and recommend. Human constraints: the engine itself must be extremely robust; if full skill-testing is impractical, the weekly iterative cleanup may be good enough — say so honestly. Brief at excursions/x4-testability-BRIEF.md; background dispatch; scoped nulls.
x4.finding: Engine already robust: 906 tests/30s, 91% coverage, every verb exercised (fear falsified; assertion quality not audited). Ranked recs: CI on existing suite (A, ~1hr); launcher resolve-at-install (A-); engine hardening residue git-collector+property tests (B+); full eval matrix declined honestly (D as gate) -> eval-on-change with scripted-principal seam on first need; #205 cheap fix (B). Field three-layer model matched; gap is enforcement not methodology.

consolidation.summary: Cycle 2 (refine, human-directed): x3+x4 landed and harvested. Ideas 29-32 added; C fork (static vs regenerate) and D risk/constraint on record; B validated as differentiator; testability constraint resolved near-term (CI + launcher-at-install + eval-on-change); package A grew to a well-evidenced ~10-item one-fell-swoop batch. Board updated; awaiting human converge/cycle-3/down-select decision.
